name: gate
purpose: Fast mandatory robot invariants. Values/tuning are not contracts; authority, safety, freshness and physical feasibility are.

tests.contract: Critical edge failure produces exactly one zero FAULT actuation.
Missing or context-mismatched actuator request fails closed and latches.
A latched FAULT cannot be cleared by a later healthy request.
Motor writer failure cannot retry positive actuation and faults lifecycle.
STOP/FAULT cancels PWM and verifies physical outputs low without ownership handoff.
Unknown/stale source time is never treated as fresh.
Critical worker startup failure aborts before runtime use.
Command producer loss/watchdog expiry publishes STOP before another heartbeat.
Launcher/developer tools cannot bypass runtime or physical hardware ownership.
Physically unrealizable motion is rejected rather than amplified; STOP remains exact zero.
Canonical kinematics preserves an already-authorized realizable twist.
Resolved live config keeps recovery, mission, operational and ingress envelopes physically consistent.
